title: Claude read-only reviewers cannot reproduce a project's canonical review-candidate identity: no supported host route covers staged, unstaged, raw untracked bytes, dirty nested submodules and gitlinks
outcome: Claude read-only reviewers cannot reproduce a project's canonical review-candidate identity: no supported host route covers staged, unstaged, raw untracked bytes, dirty nested submodules and gitlinks
acceptance: One supported, bounded read-only freeze-identity/inventory operation (host API and the MCP tool reviewers call) returns an exact, documented, verifiable canonical identity for a worktree covering the index, unstaged tracked changes, raw untracked file bytes, and dirty nested submodules and gitlinks, without granting the caller arbitrary shell, script, git -C, or file-write capability

Both a Claude and a Codex readOnly /review-code child obtain that identity end to end and compare it with the parent's frozen value; the review procedure names this operation as the identity check, retiring the per-project workaround scripts for reviewers; an unsupported shape is refused with a named reason, never a weaker substitute

Focused tests cover each input class above, the refusal case, and a real Claude plus Codex review-pair identity match; the change passes the full gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding
